Rule C reports one warning ('Oskar' matched inside 'Oskarżasz' at [19:43]), which is a known false positive of the validator's own raw-substring Rule C check (no word-boundary enforcement on multi-char targets) rather than a missed mention — confirmed false by manual reading of that line, which is Kryspin accusing the narrator of 'oskarżanie' (accusing) people, not a reference to a person named Oskar. Entries flagged 'AMBIGUOUS' in their notes are lower-confidence judgement calls made from context (garbled ASR tokens, truncated words, or wordplay/nicknames not listed verbatim as aliases) and should be spot-checked by a human reviewer.
